task: How to set a recurring calendar event
query: How do I set a recurring calendar event?

goal.title: Create and adjust a calendar event on a smartphone
goal.description: Open a mobile calendar, enter an event title, adjust its settings and notes, save it, and browse the calendar and event details to check the entry.
goal.final_state: The calendar shows the saved event among dated entries while the phone remains held in the left hand.
procedure: Unlock the phone, search for the calendar application and open its colored agenda view.
Open the event editor and type an event title beginning with finishing the working week.
Tap date/time and other event settings, scroll through the form and open selection lists.
Edit the location or related text and add notes in the event form.
Save the entry, return to the calendar, and repeatedly open its details while scrolling through nearby dates.
